scope: A01 J-PWR GH cable (H-J-PWR-1..4) between A01:J-PWR:local and A01:J-PWR:middle; separate from the DIN correction

wire_od_mm.basis: upper end of the JST GH applicable insulation OD 0.76-1.0 (Stage28 harness-policy)

bundle_diameter_factor.basis: four round conductors packed in a circle: (1 + sqrt 2) x OD

placement_margin_mm.basis: allowance for wire placement and part tolerance; clearance unqualified

component_body_height_mm.basis: envelope above the face for A01 SMD/SOIC parts whose heights Stage10 does not record

min_bend_radius_mm.basis: 5 x OD for comparison only; the harness maker must state the real limit (Q-H01/Q-H02)

foreign_unknown_depth_top_z_mm.basis: Stage10 gives no depth behind the locked foreign hardware PCBs (z 21.6); Stage30 caps that unknown volume at the A01-middle carrier front; route-study reports the cap at which each candidate would meet it

release_travel_mm.basis: Stage10 GH release sweep: mated 7.3 mm plus 15 mm axial release

service_slack_mm.basis: Stage10 minimum proxy slack rule for GH cuts

candidates.title: Bypass the J-SIG middle release sweep at proxy height
Run in the slot between the middle carrier rail top and the A01-middle front face
Wrap below the jack board edge and pass in front of the middle carrier
Pass a local relief in the middle carrier left rail (minimum change, proposal only)

modification.status: PROPOSAL_NOT_ADOPTED; needs owner approval and a mechanical re-check of the middle carrier rail
